release_name: Offline fix, working updates, corrected schedule and locations
notes: Promotes beta v27.6.3 through v27.6.13 to production in one release. The two most important fixes affect every user. (1) OFFLINE: modules/feastdoc.js is a static import of app.js and render.js but was never precached, so offline the module failed, app.js never evaluated, and the app rendered its shell with ZERO Masses while looking like it had loaded - proven end to end and then confirmed on an iPhone in airplane mode. (2) UPDATES: the service worker installed with cache.addAll using the default cache mode, so it precached whatever the browser HTTP cache already held. GitHub Pages serves assets with Cache-Control max-age=600 while the update CHECK deliberately bypasses that cache, so for ten minutes after every deploy the banner appeared and the update could not possibly succeed: the new worker installed the OLD app and the banner came straight back. Reproduced exactly, then fixed and re-proved. Also: a failed update check no longer reports Already up to date; the iOS location guidance no longer tells users to find a Settings entry that does not exist and instead gives the workaround verified on the device; Near me now distinguishes a real refusal from a momentary signal failure and no longer traps the user for the latter; a hung location request can no longer freeze the retry button. DATA: the Monastere du Carmel at Bonne-Terre added (08:00 daily, public welcome, with a time-may-vary advisory and phone); Saint-Sacrement Tuesday and Thursday celebrations added; Sainte-Anne Stanley exposition corrected to the 07h00 the diocese states; twelve source links repaired including nine that pointed at the generic index while promising a specific parish page; Saint-Odile corrected to Sainte-Odile; Saint-Coeur-de-Marie town corrected from Bambous to Petite-Riviere; and 19 sites moved from village-level to site-level coordinates. 426 rows, 121 sites. Verified against the diocesan pages: 506 of 534 published entries match a corpus row exactly.
